title: Apricorn Xmas Trees
description: Resource Pack for the Cobblemon mod to make Apricorn Trees green for Xmas.
body:
This Resource Pack re-colors Apricorn Leaves in the Cobblemon Mod for Minecraft Java to green for use in Xmas Trees. The colored Apricorns can represent lights and/or ornaments. Only the visual texture of Apricorn leaves has changed. 
[Apricorn Xmas Tree](https://imgur.com/a/vpchDHr)
